author: Fouled
body:
Hey guys, im proud to announce that Rage inc.s newest build is now finished! and ready to be released. I would like to thank everyone who has helped in this epic build. It includes epic snowy biome, with castles and many more! These are the people that helped.
Main Builder: Slicorn, Cobalt838
Helpers: Evocal, ParaSpider, MLGtino, cole1crc, steven5703, Lord Dakr and EB productions.
Slicorn:                   Cobalt:             Evocal:                  ParaSpider:            MLGtino:
Castle builder      Dam builder        Castle roofs             Air balloons              Add lights
Dam builder         Make mid         Some mountains        World Edit             Interior Designer
Terra-former         Place trees
Add lights             Help houses
Make mid            World edit
Place trees      
Help houses
Map idea

cole1crc:                            steven5703:                  Lord Dakr:                       EB productions:
Boats near bridge              Monument maker             Houses                           Teaching how to make 
Place trees                          Spectator spawn          Ships outside dam                 walls
                                              World edit

So i would like to thank all these people who have helped me on completing this amazing map!  
Map Name: Flowdren
Server: Nebula DTM
Creator: Slicorn
Main builders: Slicorn and Cobalt838
Helpers: Evocal, ParaSpider, MLGtino, cole1crc, steven5703, Lord Dakr and EB productions
YML: Soon to come!
Download: Soon to come!
Pictures: (Some of the chunks didn't load, but oh well).
